basic_details.job_title: SGPGIMS Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Sanjay Gandhi Post-Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences (SGPGIMS) has notified 1 temporary vacancy for the Project Research Scientist I (non-medical) post in Lucknow under advertisement number R/27/2026-27. The engagement is for an initial period of one year with a monthly pay of Rs. 56,000.00 + 20% HRA. Candidates must possess a First Class Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG in Biological Sciences, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics or Biotechnology or Second-class post-graduate degree, including integrated PG degree in Biological Sciences, Biochemistry, and be maximum 35 years of age.

how_to_apply: Prepare your detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) and an application on plain paper.
Include the Advertisement Number (R/27/2026-27) and the name of the post clearly in the application.
Email the CV and application to [email protected].
Ensure the application reaches the designated email address on or before 21 October 2026. Applications received after this date will not be considered for screening or interview.
Bring your original documents, one self-attested copy of all qualification and experience documents (if any), and two self-attested passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

content_sections.heading: SGPGIMS Project Research Scientist I (non-medical) at a Glance

rows.details: Sanjay Gandhi Post-Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences (SGPGIMS), Lucknow
Stem Cell Research Center, Department of Hematology
Multi-Omics Investigation of Amniotic Fluid Mesenchymal Stromal Cells: Linking Isolated Congenital Heart Defects Pathogenesis to Cellular and Molecular Dysregulation
One year (may be extended based on satisfactory performance and project duration)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification provides for a total of 1 vacancy under the ICMR-funded extramural research project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential educational qualifications specified for the Project Research Scientist I (non-medical) post. Possession of desirable qualifications is an added advantage for shortlisting.

rows.essential_qualification: First Class Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees in Biological Sciences, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics or Biotechnology OR Second-class post-graduate degree, including the integrated PG degree in Biological Sciences, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics or Biotechnology, with a PhD
rows.desirable_qualification: Prior hands-on experience in stem cell biology, including isolation, culture, characterization, and differentiation; cardiovascular research; and molecular and cell biology, with a good academic record

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated emolument of Rs. 56,000.00 plus 20% HRA per month. The initial appointment is for one year, which may be extended subject to the candidate's satisfactory performance and the duration of the project. The post is entirely temporary and can be terminated with one month's notice.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: In cases where a large number of candidates apply for the position, a screening process will be conducted based on the expertise and experience specified in the desirable qualifications. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 23 October 2026 at 10:30 AM onwards in the Conference Room, Stem Cell Research Center, Academic Block, 1st Floor, New Hematology Building, I Block, SGPGIMS, Raebareli Road, Lucknow-226014, India. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is exactly 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist I (non-medical) post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the CV and application by email is 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a First Class Post Graduate Degree in Biological Sciences, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics, or Biotechnology (including integrated PG), or a Second-class post-graduate degree in the same fields with a PhD.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 56,000.00 plus 20% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their CV and an application on plain paper including the advertisement number and post name via email to [email protected] by 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. When and where will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held on 23 October 2026 from 10:30 AM onwards in the Conference Room, Stem Cell Research Center, Academic Block, 1st Floor, New Hematology Building, I Block, SGPGIMS, Lucknow.

faq.question: Q9. Is the position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is entirely temporary for an initial period of one year, extendable based on performance and project duration.
